note: The Comisión Nacional de Bancos y Seguros's 2022 bulletin on the Central de Información Crediticia: supervised institutions report their loans and their payment status monthly, with no threshold, written as 30 days; for consumer credit, credit cards among it, negative information stops being reported 90 days after the debt is paid; unpaid, a debt between 200 and 3,000 dollars stays two years after its 90 days in arrears (over 3,000 dollars, five years; the game keeps the two).

sources.title: CNBS, Boletín Informativo CIC 2022
